definitions.gloss: misplaced resentment; bearing a grudge against someone who has done nothing wrong
definitions.explanation: resenting someone who was in the right or who was trying to help, often by twisting blame onto them

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{逆恨|さかうら}みだ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧{逆恨|さかうら}み⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I warned them, they bore a grudge against me for it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逆恨|さかうら}み⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{傷|きず}ついた→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧。
examples.english: I said it out of kindness, but they held it against me and I was hurt.

notes:
FORMS:
{逆|さか} (reverse, opposite) + ⟦{恨|うら}み→恨み：00414_urami⟧ (grudge, resentment) → reversed grudge
The resentment is "reversed" because it's directed at the wrong person.
{逆恨|さかうら}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to bear a misplaced grudge)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{恨|うら}み→恨み：00414_urami⟧ (grudge, resentment)
- ⟦{恨|うら}む→恨む：00415_uramu⟧ (to resent)
- ⟦{逆|ぎゃく}ギレ→逆ギレ：17470_gyakugire⟧ (getting angry when one is in the wrong - slang)

USAGE:
Often used when someone who was being helped or corrected turns their anger on the helper instead of reflecting on their own behavior. The person bearing {逆恨|さかうら}み is typically seen as unreasonable.
